title: Patch Mechanic Role Kit
production_method: deterministic Pillow compile; no image generation
fit_policy: contain / no crop of visible subject; white-edge trimming used only to improve placement
source_basis: Harley supplied and approved the hero image plus six alternate images in chat.
guidance: Keep Patch recognisable: teal hoodie, hood antennae, off-white face panel, black oval eyes, and black crossbody bag with > mark.
Mechanic role reads through workwear, utility details, tools, repair-action language, and workshop prop set.
Do not create a second hood position: if the hood is up over Patch's head, it is not also down around the neck.
Preserve the approved side, back, action, detail, and prop views as continuity anchors.
Use clean white-background source art with readable full-body, action, detail, and prop views.
qa_notes: Source set already accepted by Harley before deterministic compile.
Side/back images are the corrected approved versions where the hood is not both up and down.
Compiled sheet has not been repo-landed in this run.
